_guide: // certificates.json - one card per certificate in the Certificates section.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per certificate: id, title. Everything else is optional and hidden when empty.
// id: unique and stable, prefix cert- (cert-001). Career Timeline references it.
// categoryId: must match an id in categories[] below.
// description: one or two sentences on what the course covered.
// issueDate / expiryDate: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. expiryDate null = does not expire.
// credentialId: shown only when section.showCredentialId is true.
// credentialUrl: full https link to the verification page. Empty = no Verify button.
// certificateImage: image path. certificateDocument: PDF path. Empty = not rendered.
// status: 'completed' or 'in-progress'. featured: true highlights the card.
// order: manual position. enabled: false hides the record.
// isSample: true marks example content; the section then shows a notice.

section.title: Certificates
section.subtitle: Courses and certifications. Both records are examples; example.com is a reserved domain used only to show the verification button.
